dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Engine status and shortcuts to the rest of the app.
dashboard.notRunning: Not running. Start a telemetry session on the Diagnostics page.
dashboard.noActivity: No activity yet. Start the engine from Diagnostics, or connect to a peer on the Network page.

network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Establish a direct, encrypted link to a peer over the internet.
network.footer: Exchange the offer/answer blobs out of band, then press Connect on both ends. Once connected, live RTT, throughput and the packet log appear on the <1>Diagnostics</1> page.
network.virtualCreateBindAddrTitle: The address this device listens on. Port 0 picks one automatically; the host address shown after creating will include the actual port to share with others.
network.virtualCollapsedHint: Not in a network yet. Create or join a game's network from that game's page (e.g. Minecraft).
network.savedAlreadyRunning: Already running — leave it first to restart it.

nodeIdentity.label: This node · fingerprint
nodeIdentity.fingerprintTitle: A short fingerprint for voice/chat verification. To connect, share your full public key (Copy public key) — that is the authoritative identifier.
nodeIdentity.copyButtonTitle: Copy the full public key — the authoritative identifier to share with a peer

peerConnection.heading: Peer Connection · manual signaling
peerConnection.connectingTitle: Handshake in progress (≤8s). Click to cancel.
peerConnection.connectTitleNoPeer: Exchange an offer/answer with a peer first
peerConnection.connectTitleRunning: Stop the telemetry-source session before connecting to a peer
peerConnection.connectTitleReady: Punch through to the peer and establish the encrypted link
peerConnection.peerInputPlaceholder: Paste your peer's offer or answer blob…
peerConnection.sendAnswerBack: Send this answer back to your peer:

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Live engine telemetry — {{mode}}.
diagnostics.elevationDefaultMessage: Administrator privileges are required to create the virtual network adapter.
diagnostics.statFecTitle: Packets rebuilt from parity instead of being lost — cumulative for this connection
diagnostics.statBlockedTitle: Packets the split-tunnel policy refused, in either direction — cumulative for this connection
diagnostics.noPacketsYet: No packets yet. Press Start, or connect to a peer on the Network page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.connectionSubtitle: Applied the next time you press Connect — not to an already-live link.
settings.forwardBroadcastTitle: Broadcast traffic (e.g. LAN game discovery) into the tunnel
settings.forwardMulticastTitle: Multicast traffic (e.g. mDNS discovery) into the tunnel
settings.fecRedundancySubtitle: Recovers up to r lost packets per group of 8, at more bandwidth.
settings.extraRoutesSubtitle: Additional networks ("address/prefix", comma-separated) to route into the tunnel beyond the peer's own subnet. Needs Administrator to actually take effect on Windows; a malformed entry is silently skipped, not rejected.
settings.relayServerSubtitle: Lets Virtual Network create/join work across the internet without port forwarding — routes through a relay server (see the Wiki for how to run one) instead of connecting directly. Leave blank for the default direct/LAN behavior.
settings.expertModeTitle: Show advanced settings (split-tunnel forwarding, FEC redundancy). Off by default; hidden settings stay in effect either way.

importError.not-an-object: That file doesn't contain a connection profile.
importError.unsupported-version: This profile was saved by an incompatible app version.
importError.invalid-forward-broadcast: The forward-broadcast value in this profile is invalid.
importError.invalid-forward-multicast: The forward-multicast value in this profile is invalid.
importError.invalid-fec-parity-shards: The FEC redundancy value in this profile is invalid.
importError.invalid-extra-routes: The extra-routed-networks value in this profile is invalid.

minecraft.title: Minecraft
minecraft.subtitle: Connection settings tuned for Minecraft's LAN-world multiplayer discovery.
minecraft.presetSubtitle: Applies broadcast + multicast forwarding and FEC redundancy r = 2 — a manual shortcut, not automatic game detection.
minecraft.networkSubtitle: Create or join a Minecraft-tagged virtual network — broadcast/multicast forwarding and FEC redundancy are pre-filled from the preset above.

relayServer.title: Relay Server
relayServer.subtitle: Host a relay from this app so other people's Virtual Networks can reach yours across the internet, without the separate relay tool.
relayServer.portTitle: The port to listen on (every interface). 0 picks one automatically.
relayServer.publicIpUnavailable: Couldn't detect your public IP — check manually at whatismyip.com
relayServer.reachabilityHint: Give people this machine's reachable address (its own IP or hostname, plus the port above) to use as their Relay Server setting. If hosting across the internet, this port needs to be forwarded on your router — this page only starts the process, it can't do that part for you.
